            "mode": "glide_scripted_query",
            "value": "(function execute(table) {\n\n    var options = [];\n\n    // Get the logged-in user's sys_id\n    var loggedInUser = gs.getUserID();\n\n    // Query sc_request table\n    var reqGR = new GlideRecordSecure('sc_request');\n    reqGR.addQuery('requested_for', loggedInUser);\n\n    // Open requests only (exclude Closed / Complete)\n    reqGR.addQuery('state', '!=', '3'); // 3 = Closed Complete (adjust if needed)\n\n    reqGR.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');\n    reqGR.query();\n\n    while (reqGR.next()) {\n        options.push({\n            value: reqGR.getUniqueValue(),          // sys_id\n            label: reqGR.getValue('number')         // Request Number (REQxxxxx)\n        });\n    }\n\n    return options;\n\n})(table);"
